nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Pair as Error Workflow on the main chase. Fires on unhandled workflow errors (complement to Gmail onError → Revert Claim branch).

parameters.content:
## Send-error stub (M4)

Pair this workflow as the **Error Workflow** on `invoice-chase.json` (settings.errorWorkflow / UI).

- **In-workflow path (preferred for Gmail node failures):** Gmail `onError: continueErrorOutput` → Revert Claim (clears `LastStageSent` / `LastSentAt`, appends Notes) so the stage can retry.
- **This Error Trigger stub:** on broader unhandled failures, best-effort set **Status=Paused** + Notes `SEND_ERROR` so the chase does not keep claiming blindly.

No secrets in this JSON. Replace spreadsheet ID; attach Sheets credential by name.
